global_goal: Describe demand variation and recommend a defensible per-period resource level with an explicit error measure and robustness evidence.
global_constraints: small synthetic sample; state uncertainty and limits

subquestions.statement: Using temperature and promotion, model demand, compare a main method against a usable baseline under one shared error definition, and quantify stability.
subquestions.goal: predict/explain demand and justify the chosen model
unknowns_or_decisions: what counts as a usable baseline
constraints: fixed seed 2026 for any stochastic check
success_criteria: main achieves lower leave-one-out RMSE than the baseline under the identical split
coefficient signs are stable under small demand perturbation
every reported number traces to a saved artifact
proposed_relationships: promotion lifts demand (both labeled proposed until estimated)
